title.zh: BRK285 自主排障参考架构（低代码推理 + 全代码持久控制）
title.en: BRK285 Autonomous Resolution Reference Architecture (Low-Code Reasoning + Pro-Code Control)

label.zh: 1. 客户工单记录系统与受管事件触发面（Dynamics 365 FACS & Power Platform）
label.en: 1. Case System of Record & Governed Trigger Plane (Dynamics 365 FACS & Power Platform)

label.zh: 2. 低代码多专员协同推理与模型上下文协议工具桥（Copilot Studio & MCP）
label.en: 2. Low-Code Multi-Specialist Orchestration & MCP Tool Bridge

label.zh: 3. 全代码持久状态机、发布质量门禁与爬山优化底座（Azure & Foundry）
label.en: 3. Pro-Code Durable State, Foundry Release Gates & Hill-Climbing Telemetry

detail.zh: 工单唯一事实源；承接客户回复、自主结案与升级人工坐席
detail.en: Case system of record; executes bounded reply, resolve, or engineer escalation

label.zh: Power Automate 与受管连接器

detail.zh: 监听新建工单与跨天追问事件，将 MCP 服务挂载为受控工具
detail.en: Fires on new cases or customer replies and exposes MCP servers as governed tools

label.zh: 受管环境防泄漏与最小权限

detail.zh: 隔离租户数据边界、隐私脱敏与角色权限，拦截越权外发
detail.en: Enforces data-loss policies, role-based access, and PII boundaries before action

label.zh: Copilot Studio 主控与六专员智能体

detail.zh: 协同调度意图识别、证据合成、追问澄清、领域专家与回复起草
detail.en: Coordinates Intent, Evidence Synthesis, Clarifier, Domain Expert & Composer

label.zh: 内置质量审校门禁（Quality Critic）

detail.zh: 在回复客户前核验证据强度与安全合规；工具超时自动触发升级兜底
detail.en: Verifies evidence grounding prior to reply; triggers escalation fallback on timeouts

label.zh: 四路 MCP 工具桥（经 APIM 网关）

detail.zh: 统一接入工单历史、排障状态、Microsoft Learn 官方文档与线上诊断遥测
detail.en: Connects Case, Resolution Services, Microsoft Learn, and Diagnostics MCPs

detail.zh: 跨数天至数周持久化单案状态、证据链、审计账本与可测决策逻辑
detail.en: Maintains multi-day per-case state, memory, audit trails, and testable decisions

label.zh: Microsoft Foundry 评测与发布门禁

detail.zh: 结合专家评分量表、基准测试集与历史重放，执行金丝雀分阶段放量
detail.en: Runs custom SME rubrics, benchmark replay, and canary staged rollouts

label.zh: Azure Monitor + ADX + Fabric 看板

detail.zh: 采集逐轮执行追踪与跨团队归属日志，驱动失败分桶与爬山迭代
detail.en: Captures turn-level traces, fault ownership, and customer resolution KPIs
